value.rationale: The early, canonical shellable non-vertex-decomposable flag complex motivates its natural cyclic and reflection quotient topology. Its quotient fundamental groups, integral torsion and sphere homotopy type exhibit substantive, sharp behavior not encoded in face counts or known shellability, and this supplies a worked example for study of reflection fixed strata in group orbit spaces.
